official_names.en: Office of the Minister of State for Administrative Reform
official_names.ar: مكتب وزير الدولة لشؤون التنمية الإدارية

summary.en: OMSAR is a Lebanese public-sector institution working on administrative reform, digital transformation, anti-corruption, and the modernization of public administration.
summary.ar: مكتب وزير الدولة لشؤون التنمية الإدارية هو جهة حكومية لبنانية تعمل على الإصلاح الإداري والتحول الرقمي ومكافحة الفساد وتحديث الإدارة العامة.

core_areas.description_en: Modernizing public administration, improving institutional effectiveness, restoring trust in public institutions, and improving the quality and efficiency of public services.
Modernizing public administration through citizen-centered government services, improved efficiency, digital systems, and redesigned administrative processes.
Supporting and coordinating reforms that strengthen integrity, transparency, accountability, and good governance.
